title: Preserve Hunch evidence command verbatim, not rendered
context: Hunch tasks return a contribution_card with an Evidence line (a command). Previous guidance said 'render link outside code block' which created ambiguity about whether to transform or copy the command exactly. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.).
decision: Changed instruction to 'Copy the card verbatim, including its Evidence line (the command that renders the local report on demand)' — enforce exact copying of the command, not presentation-based rendering.
consequences: Evidence commands preserve exact syntax needed to regenerate reports
Removes risk of accidental transformation breaking reproducibility
Evidence trail is auditable by running the copied command
alternatives_rejected: Keep 'render outside code block' guidance — ambiguous whether command could be reformatted
Rely on agent judgment for where/how to display evidence — leads to inconsistent preservation

rejected_tripwires.alternative: Keep 'render outside code block' guidance — ambiguous whether command could be reformatted
Rely on agent judgment for where/how to display evidence — leads to inconsistent preservation
